metadata.description: Skills & tools for Sound Flow — nine browser audio studios sharing one library, one config codec and one substrate.

plugins.name: sound-flow-vibe
plugins.description: Vibe Sound Flow with words: pick the studio, author a seeded config against its schema, and deliver a #sfa= link that opens the studio with the sound already loaded — beats, synth patches, ambient beds, slicing, loops, narration, analysis, tape character, and full mixes.
